title: Executive Order No. 40, s. 2023
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
MANILA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 40

EXTENDING THE MORATORIUM ON THE PAYMENT OF THE
PRINCIPAL OBLIGATION AND INTEREST OF THE AMORTIZATION
DUE AND PAYABLE BY AGRARIAN REFORM BENEFICIARIES

WHEREAS, Executive Order (EO) No. 4 (s. 2022) imposed a one (1)-year
moratorium on the payment of the principal obligation and interest of the amortization due
and payable by Agrarian Reform Beneficiaries (ARBs) under the Comprehensive
Agrarian Reform Program (CARP) and other agrarian reform programs or laws;

WHEREAS, under Republic Act (RA) No. 11953 or the “New Agrarian
Emancipation Act,” individual loans of ARBs, including interests, penalties and
surcharges were condoned and written off, and ARBs were exempted from payment of
estate tax on agrarian reform lands secured under the CARP or other agrarian reform
programs or laws, which were due and payable by covered ARBs as of the date of
effectivity of the law on 24 July 2023;

WHEREAS, Section 2 of RA No. 11953 provides that there are 346,432 of the total
610,054 ARBs tilling 763,894.66 hectares of agrarian reform lands, whose names and
other loan details of indebtedness to the Government have yet to be submitted to
Congress by the Land Bank of the Philippines (LBP) and the Department of Agrarian
Reform (DAR);

WHEREAS, according to the DAR, apart from those whose names and other loan
details have yet to be submitted to Congress pursuant to RA No. 11953, there are new
ARBs who may not be able to take advantage of the relief provided under the said law
because they were not covered by the cut-off date when the law became effective on 24
July 2023;

WHEREAS, in furtherance of the objective of RA No. 11953 of emancipating the
ARBs from financial burden, it is imperative to extend the period of the moratorium under
EO No. 4 to ensure that sustained economic relief will benefit both ARBs to be covered
by RA No. 11953 and those excluded therefrom, and afford them protection from the ill
effects of the current state of our global economy; and

THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
 
WHEREAS, Section 17, Article VII of the Constitution vests in the President the
power of control over all Executive departments, bureaus and offices, and the mandate
to ensure the faithful execution of laws;

NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND R. MARCOS, JR., President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution and existing laws,
do hereby order:

Section 1. Extension of Moratorium. The moratorium on the payment of the
principal value and annual interest of the amortization due and/or payable by ARBs under
EO No. 4 shall be extended for a period of two (2) years.

Section 2. Implementing Rules and Regulations. Within fifteen (15) days from
the effectivity of this Order, the DAR and LBP shall jointly formulate the rules and
regulations for the implementation of this Order, in accordance with existing general
banking laws, the rules and regulations of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, EO No. 228
(s. 1987), RA No. 6657 or the “Comprehensive Agrarian Reform Law of 1988,” as
amended, RA No. 11953, and other relevant laws and issuances.

Section 3. Funding. The funds for the implementation of this Order, including its
monitoring and evaluation, shall be charged against the existing and available
appropriations of the DAR and LBP, subject to relevant budgeting, accounting and
auditing laws, rules and regulations.

Section 4. Separability. If any part or provision of this Order shall be held
unconstitutional or invalid, the other provisions not affected thereby shall continue to be
in full force and effect.

Section 5. Repeal. This Order hereby amends or modifies relevant provisions of
EO No. 4. All other issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts thereof that are
inconsistent with this Order, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Section 6. Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon publication
in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.

DONE, in the City of Manila, this 12th dayof September __, in the year of
Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Three.

 

By the President:

Office of the President
MALACANANG RECORDS OFFICE

2 CERTIF COPY

 

ATTY, CONCEPCION

REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES

UV AAMT Ta

PBBMOO;
